beats.text: You get up off the shoulder of Lakeshore Drive and start walking. Your legs remember the way home before you do.
Lake Ulysses at this hour: sprinklers ticking, a church sign missing half its letters, a dog barking at the water like it owes him money.
Your building. Three flights. The stairwell smells like lemon cleaner and somebody else's dinner.
Third floor. {pause:300}One door down the hall is propped open. Someone inside is humming a hymn, a little off-key.
